avis.texte: Kakadu oil has been SOO amazing! I have been using it for over a year now, and it feels absolutely wonderful on my face. It is very nourishing, moisturizing, and it leaves a beautiful glow! It feels so good and seeps into my skin! I have been buying this multiple times already, and I will certainly be coming back for more!

I purchased a tester size of the Kakadu Beauty Oil, and I like it so much, I plan to purchase a full size, and replace my current facial oil. I have dry skin, but I'm able to use the Kakadu followed by the RMS Primer, then start my makeup. This routine keeps me hydrated all day, and I never feel dry or itchy.
I don't usually write reviews, but this is my favorite product. I use it day and night and my skin is glowing, post partum hasn't been kind on my skin, but this has helped me keep my pregnancy glow.

avis.titre: Fan for life of this oil!
avis.texte: Beautiful oil to use day or night and has immediately become one of my favorite RMS products overnight! I've used many expensive clean lines from Ogee to Tata Harper to Pai and this is one of my favorite oils ever! It's light and soaks right in immediately. I have dry skin for reference. I use it day and night under a serum or moisturizer. A little goes a long way just a few drops needed!
I have only been using Kakadu oil for a month. I love how it leaves my skin feeling soft and moist. I apply it at night after cleansing my skin and I wake up growing.
It goes on smooth and my skin doesn't feel greasy at all. Great product!
Thank you for creating an awesome Kakadu oil . It's very soothing and hydrating. Thanks again.

I never thought I'd buy oil for my face, but I tried this due to so many enthusiastic comments — and now I'm a believer, too. A little does go a long way, and it's so versatile (and particularly useful when traveling). I was always unsure of mixing items on the back of my hand, but this plus Un-Cover Up provide amazing coverage for so little of each. And alone it gives a nice refresh to day-long makeup. Thanks to RMS for the size options.
I've loved this product! As I have aged, I find my skin needs more than a lotion moisturizer. This provides everything I need for my skin to stay hydrated and luminous all day long.

This is my go to oil for everything! It's not greasy it makes your skin glow. Especially for us mature skin women. Thank you Marie for making a clean and beautiful product. Trust me you need this in your life.

I purchased this for my husband to use for his skincare routine. His skin was getting very dry and flaky from shaving and sun exposure. It is now a regular part of his routine after shaving and under sunscreen when we go to the beach. His skin is now moist and glowing!
The only skin oil I will ever use for hydration. A must have in your skin care routine any questions just watch the videos
This oil has replaced my bougie med spa products. LOVE this! IT has transformed my dry post-menopausal skin to soft and glowing without the break outs. I am sold!
I love RMS products. It is clean and I do not worry about using RoseMarie products especially since having cataract surgery. Would buy and recommend RMS again and again. Thanks
I love this oil. My friend asked me what I was doing different and I told her about the oil. She ordered some and informed me she could bath in it she loves it so much.
I find this oil to be very hydrating and nourishing for my skin. The texture is light but very potent. I have dry skin so this oil is my new best friend.
Love the Beauty Oil but when I ordered this time you only had 20ml size & then outrageous price for 30ml size. What happened to the 15ml size like I originally ordered?
My favorite facial oil. I like that it is easily absorbed even with my mature skin, and the fragrance is lovely.

Wow is this oil hood. It feels wonderful and takes the place of my moisturizer. I usually don't love smells in my face product and I avoid synthetic fragrance. This smell is from natural oils and I like it and more importantly my sensitive skin loves it ! I've tried other clean oils and they just sit on top of my skin. I don't like that. This RMS one sinks right in. It's a soothing drink of water for me skin!
Only been using it for a few days but it's very comforting. It goes on rich and oily and sinks right in. Makes my skin look much better.

At age 74, my skin drinks in this beauty oil. I have tried other brands that simply sat on the surface of my skin and got onto my clothes. I also feel comfortable using a product with clean, organic ingredients. rms is a brand I trust.
I love all the products from RMS they work so well on my skin from start to finish. They feel light and not heavy and provide the perfect canvas for the rest of the day.
This has become my go to skin prep in the morning underneath the primer. It gives my skin, the most beautiful glow on my makeup glides on beautifully.
My face drank this stuff up! But afterwards my face didn't feel oily

avis.titre: this facial oil tests well for me
avis.texte: my holistic health care practitioner tested the oil for me and it tests very well, i will need to figure out how to use it with other products I use.

This oil has completely changed the health and appearance of my complexion. LASTING hydration, healthy glow. Has made the application of tinted moisturizers, sunscreen, cream moisturizers and serums so much easier- feel like my skin is great shape / more receptive and open to the good ingredients in everything else I use.

This is a must have vitamin c oil in the travel size for on the go. I cannot live without this oil. My face transformed an became so clear because of this golden juice. So im glad they have all sizes to take with us.
I gift this to all of the mothers in my family! Their skin feels hydrated, balanced, and glowy when makeup is applied. Never going without an oil on my face! My skin has never looked better.

I have tried a lot of facial oils and nothing compares. This is my absolute favorite — full stop. It absorbs instantly, never feels greasy, and leaves my skin visibly glowing and deeply hydrated all day. The Kakadu Plum and adaptogenic herbs are next level. I layer it under my moisturizer and it mix it with UnCoverup concealer for a radiant look.

What a luxurious, healthy glow this gives my skin! It plumps up my regular moisturizer but more importantly, my skin feels rejuvenated. I am enamored by this product and look forward to trying the full line!

I LOVE this oil. I have aging skin which includes wrinkles around my mouth. I have had fillers and laser treatments and would still wake up and see tiny negative differences everyday until I started using this product. It has stopped my lines and wrinkles in their tracks. I see some softening in the lines, yes, but can't get over how soft, smooth and hydrated the rest of my face has become. Thank you so much!
Haven't had it very long but it feels wonderful on my dry skin
i've always been hesitant to try an oil on my face- combination skin- but this has been wonderful. skin is softer, and even better red discoloration is fading. High recommendation!
This oil is ahhhmazing! Goes on smooth and hydrates. Makes my skin glow.

After trying numerous oils by RMS competitors this is truly superior to them! Moisturizing all day and leaves a beautiful healthy glow to your skin. Add RMS primer as the icing on the cake!! Beautiful combo . Never stop making this RMS! This is my 4th order of this product and I'm sure there will be many more !
Love this two drop oil to moisturize under the foundation base makeup and some nighttime nourishment. Feeds the skin without unnecessary chemical ingredients!
Love all the RMS products. Thisoil feels luxurious and keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy
I had been looking for a natural approach to skincare. And Kakadu Beauty Oil exceeds all my expectations…it truly is amazing. Thank you, Rose Marie!

This feels like a big drink of water for my face and I have normal skin. I love the feel, the texture and the moisture it provides my aging skin. I have used it in the morning under my base and it is part of my nighttime skincare routine.
I am loving how light this oil is . My skin soaks up all the goodness this oil has to offer. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and gives me a beautiful glow.
The Kakadu Beauty Oil feels like luxury. I use it to hydrate my skin every night after I prep and wash off my makeup from the day. I will be keeping this is my bag of tricks. Thanks RMS!
My 60 something skin LOVES this product! I use it over my estriol cream and my skin remains soft and moisturized. So happy to took a chance a tried this amazing oil.
Can't live without this oil! First thing I reach for after cleansing. It goes on so smoothly and never leaves your skin greasy. Sinks in like a charm.

I live this oil! I'm 70, and I've used this oil for a couple of years now. I have normal type skin and I use it every morning to start my day. My face has never felt oily and still feels supple hours later.

This oil is a must have in my daily routine. It makes for a beautiful nourishing base before applying makeup. It also makes makeup application seamless and adds a natural glow. This is the first time I have used an oil in my daily routine …just buy it …so worth it!

This oil is so good, I'm on my second bottle I use it on my scalp and face. It's helped reduce texture and redness for me. I've simplified my routine with this, it's so absorbent and has a refreshing sent.

I use the Kakadu Beauty Oil every night and wake up with soft, well nourished skin- for someone with very dry, mature, sensitive skin that's impressive! I also mix a drop in with my foundation (or under sunscreen in the morning) for a healthy glow.

This is wonderful! There is a citrus like smell but I don't find it overly strong once on or offensive. This is very concentrated and absorbing. You need to give a bit to absorb completely. So set a timer and do other things. It's not greasy looking or feeling. It feels fantastic on the neck and chest. I even use the extra on the back of my hands and it took years off feel and look. I tend to be normal to combination skin based on the time of year. I do have a small window of time that I'm dry. This is fantastic for selective placement so I can give the moisture to exactly the right spots.

The Kakadu Beauty Oil is my absolute favorite skin care. My skin feels so soft and smooth. I had recently run out of the product. While waiting for my new one to arrive I could tell my skin was lacking it! I was so happy when it arrived!!!
I love love the Kakadu oil. I've been using it for over a year and notice the suppleness of my skin, I get many compliments. Now getting my husband to use it.

avis.titre: Excellent purchase, will continue to use
avis.texte: I really like this product. I use it on no-makeup days, especially, after I've washed and exfoliated; it isn't greasy in the slightest, absorbs well, smells fresh, and seems to genuinely nourish my skin. I have not had any adverse reactions to it (breakouts, texture changes, etc. ). I also use it on my neck and the backs of my hands. I use tretinoin at night and also take Spirolactone, so hydration is extremely important to me - this is a fabulous addition to my skincare. Even at 45 I am still a little acne prone; I am confident this will not contribute to any of those issues.
Love this product. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly into my skin. Leaves my skin feeling silky soft.
Took a chance on this product and have been so pleased! It smells great, lasts a long time and works wonderfully as my morning moisturizer before makeup. 10/10!

The scent of this luxurious facial oil is so light. I feel emotionally and physically nurtured each morning and night as I spread 3 drops on my face, neck and décolletage. This is truly the nicest weight, fragrance and product I have ever used on my face. Wish I was told about it sooner.

Okay I admit I LOVE everything RMS but this has to be one of my favorites. I use a little at night under the Kakadu Lux moisturizer. It's an amazing combo. I'm 49 and use Altreno (Rx retinoid). I've been using that for a long time. I added RMS oil and moisturizer around November; its currently April. My skin is positively radiant. Only a centimeter is gone at this point so the bottle may last me a year. I also use it on my neck and chest (more liberally there).
Works well to nourish my mature skin Feels like it stops time Wonderful product
Definitely one of my favorite RMS products! All of them together have transformed my skin. NO break outs, my skin tone looks more even, just so much better in general.
Love this oil! Just the right hydration for the warmer weather without feeling greasy. Also great under my sunscreen. Love the dewey look😊
This Kakadu oil is just ok. I can feel it on my skin under my makeup. I ordered a small bottle and didn't or anymore.
I love this product! I have sensitive skin. This I can use day and nite. . . using N evening refreshing spritz. 🌹

I love this product!! It's part of my daily and nightly plan! It seems to bring a balance to my look each day. I have a glow and I've even been asked what my skin routine is! Isn't that something!! So yes, kakadu is for YOU and me!
Wonderful , one of my favorite everyday essentials I love the was my skin feels , hydrated and easy to apply and a little bit goes a long way . I feel it gives me a youthful appearance !
This is the first oil that hasn't been uncomfortable for me to wear. Feels so nice!
Gently scented. Great after skin tint/foundation on dry spots or for a dewy finish.

I've never ever been able to use any oils on my face. This is the first! It makes my skin feel so good and my skin drinks it up immediately before I put on the moisturizer. It has a very very light fragrance… Hardly a fragrance really… Just feels so good and clean and my skin loves it.

I used this oil a while ago, tried a different brand but then came back to RMS oil. It truly is so nice and smells wonderful. I use it around my eyes and face and neck but I do avoid my t-zone. That is all I need for my combo skin! Simple skincare.

This is a must in my daily routine! I mix this with the primer, and my skin feels incredibly hydrated despite living in the desert. For days at home, I just put this on my skin for a beautiful glow. The product lasts FOREVER! Despite using this literally every single day, a bottle will last me 5-6 months. I have soooo many RMS products, but this is truly in my top 3 favorites.

I bought this when the weather started getting cold and used it under my makeup and at night to seal in my nightly skincare products. It is not real heavy and sinks into the skin. I also use it on my cuticles. The price point is a high but the quality wins!
I but the oil on over a serum and then my moisturizer. I like to layer my products. Highly recommend.

It is hard for me to pick a favorite RMS product, but the Kakadu Oil is absolutely one of them. I have using the oil for less than a year and I can not tell you the difference it's made in my skin. I struggle with dryness and combinations skin, but the Kakadu Oil helps me manage both by moisturizing and not being so oily that everything slides off. It does not take much to make a difference in the texture and/or smoothness of face and neck, etc. I use it faithfully and recommend the same.
Oh, this is very favorite product from RMS. I use it on a clean face and my skin slurps it up! I absolutely love it!

avis.titre: Great combined with skin tint or similar
avis.texte: Pleasant scent, not too heavy. I found it works best for my skin when I apply it right after my skin tint (or the like).
I love using the cockatoo beauty oil daily- either right after the Lux cream or on its own. I even use it all over my eyes, and it feels awesome. One of my favorite RMS products!

Love this! Have never used an oil out of fear it would create a slick on my face. Couldn't be further from reality. A small amount applies nicely andu skin is very happy and hydrated. Very glad I stumbled onto this product line.

I have combination skin-oily t-zone, but also drying from tretinoin use. This oil is nice. It is light with a light scent, none irritating, with clean ingredients and good price for the amount of oil you get. I have a small face and if I use more than 3 drops, my face will look oily unless I massage it well. It does give some hydration. I only use it at night and have not notice a reduction in redness or anything else with it. Will finish the bottle, but not sure if I'd buy it again. I will also try under makeup to see if it does anything.

avis.titre: Favorite new product in my collection
avis.texte: This oil feels great the minute I spray it on. It's a lovely light scent. Makes my skin feel healthy. Not too oily.

avis.titre: Really like but shipping took too long
avis.texte: I have been mixing this with Kakadu Lux Cream and really like it. I feel like the affect on my skin lasts throughout the day, I will buy it again. Also, it did not ship for over a week and it took 2 weeks to get to me. I also ordered the same day from Jones Road and had that package in 4 days,
I love this oil. I use it morning and night and it really helps my skin feel soft and properly moisturized.
Very moisturizing on the skin, which I love living in the cold climate. My skin feels hydrated all day.

I really like how Kakadu Beauty Oil provides much needed hydration for my face. It is the first RMS Beauty product I put on my face after cleansing both day and night. I find it a great mix when my next product is the Kakadu Luxe Cream. Recently I was without my Beauty Oil because I thought I had an extra in my stash. Waited patiently for my order to arrive. The selection to purchase the size is appreciated. However since the oil immediately provides the hydration I need, I never want to run out again! A much needed product for any skin or age.
I love this beauty oil! It gives a fresh, dewy look without feeling or looking oily. I like to mix it with a small amount of the Kakadu Luxe Cream for the perfect texture and prep for my makeup.

Kakadu Beauty Oil is the product I didn't know I needed. Whenever my skin feels a little dry, I warm a few drops up between my palms and gently press my cheeks and anywhere else I'm feeling parched. It soaks into my face quickly, without feeling greasy and lasts longer than using just a moisturizer. I'm hooked on Kakadu Beauty Oil.
I haven't used this oil long enough to testify to any long term benefits but it so far I like it and it's not greasy but is still hydrating. The smell is also really nice!
Love how smooth it glides over my face and that I can layer it in with my skin care products.
Great oil to give that added boost during periods of dryness. Doesn't clog pores and smells great.

I suffer from really dry eyelids and undereye area. On a lark I used the smallest oil sent as a gift from rms overnight and I woke up with brighter, softer eye area. No irritation and quite the miracle worker!!!! Happy discovery. I use a very small amount bc the rest of my skin is oily even though I am fifty and follow up with the biphasÃ© serum spray (two spritzes). Good winter regimen; we'll see about the summer!
I've been using this oil for years and it really is not a daily oil for me, mainly in the winter or when it's dry. It's nonirritating and non greasy.

This is a miracle product for me! When I turned 50, my skin changed (all you peri- menopause ladies know what I'm talking about!) and natural products I had used for years no longer worked since my skin was suddenly dry, flaking, and dull. I found RMS and started using several products including the Kakudu oil. All I can say is THANK YOU, Rose-Marie! I get zero reactions (highly reactive skin), my face is much less dry and makeup doesn't cake and settle as much. I recently took a new executive head shot and there is no retouching of any kind. RMS makeup and skin care made me look glowing!

Feels amazing on the skin. You don't need a lot. All the texture on my face has all but disappeared. I'm 63 and still have oily skin. This product works miracles. In a few short weeks, my lines are less deep, less noticeable and skin more refined. Works well on your neck as well. Thank you :relaxed:ï¸ so so much! Mary.
I live in the California desert and this oil is perfect for keeping my skin hydrated but not oily! It just soaks in and is the perfect canvas for my spf makeup!

avis.titre: Love the scent of this oil
avis.texte: I love this oil! It feels good on my skin and is not greasy. I use it alone or with moisturizer over it. I especially love the smell ❤ï¸. This is my first RMS purchase but it won't be my last!
Makes washing your face a treat! I love the feel of this cleanser,light and fresh while being super effective. Very light, pleasant scent. Works quickly and washes off easily. I'm hooked!

This is my new favorite face oil which I replaced GÃ©nifique by LancÃ´me. Kakadu provides great moisture and a little goes a long way. It absorbs really well and isn't greasy The price is reasonable also.
I love the RMS products. Everyone always asks what I am doing with my skin saying it looks so hydrated. I am 63 years old.

avis.titre: Such an amazing oil, pretty expensive
avis.texte: I got a small sample of this with one of my orders, and it was amazing! I loved you could wear it under makeup even though it's an oil. I don't plan on buying the regular sized bottle though, since the price is so high. Maybe I will catch a sale in the future.

This oil is a game changer and has made an amazing difference to my lifelong dry skin. For over a year, I've smoothed on a couple drops into my face before bed. The scent is so comforting, the oil feels so nourishing. I've actually had to cut back on how much I use because my skin is so much healthier now. I got a tiny vial as a gift with my first purchase and it made me a forever fan.
A beautiful, clean feeling oil that leaves my face dewy and glowing. The texture of my skin has noticeably improved during this harsh winter. Love this Kakadu!
This lovely oil is surprisingly light and effective. It absorbs quickly and softens my deep lines. I use a drop of Kakuda Oil with my UnCoverup Cream Foundation for glowing results.
Fabulous. I use every night and it's super nourishing- great product I've reordered.
Just as described this oil feels non-greasy and absorbs quickly leaving my skin aglow.
This is a great beauty oil. Have tried others and some can smell kind of strange. This goes on smooth and not heavy at all. Woke up and my skin was very smooth and fresh.
Just the right amount of moisture! A little goes a long way! I use after my serums and press into my skin! Use remaining on my neck! Can't wait to use in the summer! Also mix with my sunscreen.
This is a good oil and fast absorbent so you will not be a grease ball. I don't see improvement in wrinkles but it is a good oil.

I LOVE this Kakadu Beauty Oil. Most facial oils leave my skin feeling sticky. This does not. It's light and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated, nourished, and soft. Thank you for this great product!

Love the Kakadu oil! On my third bottle and think it does a great job hydrating my skin. It absorbs quickly, and my skin seems to be happy with no reactions. Having a damp face when applying is helpful, as it doesn't move around much as it's a dry oil, it doesn't remain greasy at all. So far, been a big fan of RMS and I will continue to purchase.

This Kakadu Beauty Oil came travel size in my skincare travel set. It is the freshest, most silky oil I've ever tried. Using the dropper, it starts gliding down my cheeks and neck before I smooth it into my skin in a way that is really sensual. Maybe that is too much information? Ha! Well, see what you think for yourself!

avis.titre: Love it! But not the scent
avis.texte: I do love this oil, I just wish it had the same pleasant scent that the hydrating mist has. I bought the mist first and since it is this oil + mineral water, I was eager to have the pure oil with the same scent. Was very disappointed that the oil itself has an unpleasant scent.
Best thing since sliced bread. My Skin is young again at 78. And getting younger.
I've only used it two times and it is very light and non greasy. Feels great on skin alone or under makeup -

I've used rosehip oil by another company for years, but received a tester of this and liked how it felt on my skin. Now I'm in a quandary when this runs out, which one do I buy! They're both as good, RMS has the edge I have to say. I fully recommend it. It's a dream to apply, a cocktail for the skin that leaves you love drunk for more!!
